paragraphs: McMichael Home Repair is Seth's home remodeling and repair business. One family asked him to replace an old kitchen desk with something useful, and he built a walk-in pantry with a sliding barn door, lit shelves and wood counters. Another had him finish 1,400 square feet of basement, complete with a bathroom and two built-in bars.

Seth is just as quick with repairs. When a storm tore a satellite dish off a roof and the board underneath had rotted, he came out the next day and fixed it in two hours. Reviewers keep using the same words: prompt, transparent, fair priced and easy to talk to.

items.name: Custom pantries and built-ins
items.blurb: Old kitchen desks and dead corners turned into useful storage. Mike's family traded their desk nook for a walk-in pantry with a white barn door, LED-lit shelves and stained wood counters, finished on time and well worth the investment.

image.alt: Custom pantry with sliding white barn door open to lit shelves and stained wood countertop

items.name: Basement finishing and bathrooms
items.blurb: Full basement build-outs and bathroom remodels. One 1,400 square foot basement became a utility area, a spare bedroom, a bathroom with a walk-in shower and a living space with two built-in bars. Google tags four more reviews for bathroom remodels.

image.alt: No basement or bathroom photo on file yet; ask Seth for project photos

items.name: Decks and exterior work
items.blurb: Outdoor projects posted on the McMichael Google profile include a raised deck with black metal railings and a full staircase down to the yard. Reviewers also mention storm door installs. Call to talk through your deck, door or exterior project.

image.alt: Raised deck with black metal railing and stairs on the back of a two-story house

items.name: Roof, storm and exterior repairs
items.blurb: Storm damage, roof patches and leak fixes, often on short notice. After a satellite dish ripped through one roof, Seth replaced the rotted board, added new underlayment and shingles, and the patch is now hard to spot.

image.alt: Repaired asphalt shingle roof with the patched area blending in

items.title: Communication first
items.text: Shaun says Seth was completely transparent, listened, gave them options and kept them up to date through their whole basement project. Seth says he always strives for that.

items.title: Prompt and on time
items.text: Google tags nine reviews for promptness. Mike says his pantry was completed on time, and Brooke had her roof fixed the day after she called.

items.title: Fair pricing
items.text: Six reviews mention fair cost. Brooke wrote that the price for her roof repair was well under what big roofing companies charge.

items.title: Repairs that disappear
items.text: Brooke says you cannot tell where her roof was repaired. Seth found and replaced the dry-rotted board under the damage instead of just patching the shingles.

about.h2: About Seth and McMichael Home Repair
about.text: McMichael Home Repair is run by Seth, who answers his own reviews and is the name customers mention on every job. His projects range from a two-hour roof repair to a full 1,400 square foot basement with a bedroom, bathroom and two built-in bars. What customers notice most is how he works: he listens, lays out options, explains costs openly and keeps you updated. Several reviewers say they plan to hire him again, and one asked for a quote on her next job right after he fixed her roof.

items.name: Shaun E.
items.text: Seth created an awesome finished basement for us.  Finished 1400 sq ft of space resulting in a useable utility space, great spare bedroom, bathroom with walk in shower and an awesome living space with two built in bar areas. He was completely transparent, listened to us, gave us options but most importantly for me was his communication. Always keeping us up to date. Would definitely work with Seth again.

items.name: Mike S.
items.text: Great experience! Seth delivered very high-quality work on a custom kitchen pantry we wanted in place of our old "kitchen desk" setup. He was efficient, prompt, and completed on time. Overall, the services were well worth the investment. We will definitely use again on future work!

items.name: Brooke R.
items.text: McMichael came out next day to fix my roof. We had a satellite dish that damaged the roof when it got blown off in a storm. The whole board underneath had dry rotted because it was sealed properly! He was friendly and professional and did an amazing job in 2 hours!!!!!!! And you can't tell where the repair is now! Already asked him for a quote on my next job! Pricing was amazing and well under big roofing companies!

service_area.h2: Home remodeling and repair near you
service_area.text: McMichael Home Repair works at customers' homes rather than from a storefront, so there is no public address. Seth has not published a list of towns yet. To find out whether he covers your neighborhood, call (314) 568-5888 Monday to Saturday between 9 AM and 5 PM, or email Seth@McMichaelHomeRepair.com with your address and a short description of the project.

items.q: Can you turn an unused kitchen desk into a pantry?
items.a: Yes. Seth replaced one family's old kitchen desk setup with a walk-in pantry: a white sliding barn door, white shelves with LED lighting and stained wood counters. The owners called it very high-quality work, finished on time and well worth the investment.

Yes. Seth finished a 1,400 square foot basement that now has a utility space, a spare bedroom, a bathroom with a walk-in shower and a living area with two built-in bars. The owners praised his transparency, his options and his regular updates.

items.q: How fast can you get to a storm repair?
items.a: It depends on the schedule, but one customer had Seth out the day after she called. A satellite dish had blown off in a storm and damaged the roof. He replaced the rotted board, finished in two hours and the repair is now hard to see.

Six Google reviews mention fair cost, and one customer says Seth's roof repair price was well under the big roofing companies. Seth explains options and costs openly before work starts, so call (314) 568-5888 to talk about your project and get a quote.

McMichael Home Repair is open Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Sunday. Call (314) 568-5888 during those hours, or email Seth@McMichaelHomeRepair.com any time with photos of the job and your address, and Seth will reply.

final_cta.text: Pantry, basement, bathroom or a storm repair: call for a quote.
